hook_note: Front-loaded trigger. The US government's published position is a lab origin (whitehouse.gov/lab-leak, CIA Jan 2025) — so 'they admitted it' is defensible. The video says 'came out of a lab', never 'engineered as a weapon'.

lines.en: The United States just admitted it.
lines.vo_direction: Straight to camera. No warm-up. Slightly too fast, like you're getting it out before you're stopped.

lines.en: COVID did not come from an animal. It came out of a lab.
And that is not even the disturbing part.
lines.vo_direction: Drop the volume. This is the retention hook.

lines.en: March twenty twenty. The world shuts down.
Sixteen days later, the Pentagon's own intelligence agency writes a document.
lines.vo_direction: Pick up pace through the line.

lines.en: Subject: one lab in Wuhan. One researcher.
It lists three things.
lines.vo_direction: Set the list up. Small pause after.

lines.en: A bank of bat coronaviruses.
The ability to build infectious clones.
And chimeric spike genes they had already engineered.
June twenty twenty. Pentagon medical intelligence runs the genome.
Three scientists reach a conclusion. Manipulated.
lines.vo_direction: Isolate the last word. Drop pitch.

lines.en: August twenty twenty-one. The President gets briefed on COVID's origin.
That conclusion, reportedly, never makes it into the room.
lines.vo_direction: Quietest line in the video. Almost throw it away.

lines.en: For six years the public answer was one word. Unknown.
It took a court order to get those pages out. They landed this year.
So when they finally admitted it, they were not discovering anything.
They were catching up to a file they wrote in the first month.
The question was never what happened.
It's who already knew.
lines.vo_direction: Full stop before this. Clean, no push.

lines.en: Twenty twenty-seven.
